card.name: Spaces and joins before numbers in pharmacology
card.fires_on: Small joining marks or spaces just before a number or measure in drug pharmacology text, such as the space after 'half-life of about' or the hyphen in 'U-300'. Also the 'al' inside 'sertraline'.

modes.label: Space before half-life figure
modes.description: The blank space right before a number giving a half-life or concentration.
modes.example: it may, for the purpose of choosing a protamine dose, be assumed to have a half-life of about<< >>30 minutes after intravenous injection.

modes.label: Hyphen or joiner in a name
modes.description: A hyphen or linking word inside a product name or a drug-level phrase.
modes.example: Higher doses of Insulin Glargine, U<<->>300 were required to achieve similar

modes.label: Inside sertraline
modes.description: The 'al' piece in the drug name sertraline.
modes.example: The normalization of prothrombin time for the sertr<<al>>ine hydrochloride group was delayed compared
